label: early original-phase steps after 3/p/l/2/i/r (weak, distributed)
predicate: (phase == 0) & (t <= 4) & isin(prev_tok, [tok("3"), tok("p"), tok("l"), tok("2"), tok("i"), tok("r")])
explanation: Diffuse candidate unit with no clean rule. It is active on about 5% of steps. 70% of activation mass falls in the original phase, mostly at t=1..3, and the remaining 30% is spread over the copy phase. It is almost silent on the delimiter step. It is boosted when the previous input is 3, 2, p, l, i or r (and when the first token is one of these), and when the current input is c, n, u, z, w or j. The strongest activations are on c or 3 right after an opening 3 or p (e.g. p 3 c, 3 3 c). These look like additive token preferences combined with early position, not one coherent condition. The best simple predicate (early original phase AND prev_tok in {3,p,l,2,i,r}) reaches only F1 of about 0.34, and conjunctions or disjunctions with the input-token set do no better (best F1 0.34, mass recall 0.56). It rarely fires at t>=5 of the original phase. Copy-phase activity peaks at recall_idx 2-4 and when outputting m, p, q or 1, and is not captured.
